char-nine.title: Nine the Phantom
char-nine.about: Nine the Phantom as a playable caster, built from her boss fight in Entropy Effect. Fast fire, wind and ice spells that commit on the press, her blink, element weaving with a spell for every combination, the Phantom's arm and leg, and her own Potentials.
char-nine.credit: Nine the Phantom and BlazBlue belong to Arc System Works. Unofficial fan work.

char-ruby.title: Ruby Rose
char-ruby.about: Ruby Rose, as she appears in BlazBlue Cross Tag Battle, as a playable character: Crescent Rose's scythe strings and Gun Blast, her own voice and effects, and her own Potentials. Part of Cross Effect, one of the Redux mods.
char-ruby.credit: Ruby Rose, RWBY and BlazBlue Cross Tag Battle belong to their owners. Unofficial fan work.

dr-party.title: DELTARUNE: Party
dr-party.about: Kris from DELTARUNE as a playable character, with Susie and Ralsei following: the sword string, the air spin, the dash and the Summon Tactic. Hold Skill and pick an enemy for the party command: Susie's Rude Buster or Ralsei's Fireshock.
dr-party.credit: DELTARUNE and its characters belong to their owners. Unofficial fan work.

bbee-sdk.title: Runtime hooks
bbee-sdk.about: Shared code the other mods run on. It goes into the game with any mod.

bbee-actors.title: Added characters
bbee-actors.about: What lets a new character appear on the Prototype select screen with its own Potentials. It goes in with any character mod.

bbee-inspector.title: Inspector
bbee-inspector.about: A battle overlay for testers and mod makers: F8 shows it, and F9 saves a report you can send with your feedback.
